messages:
Noah V: Quick thread to lock a different approach for the observability beta: 'incident-snapshot first' rather than full trace explorer. Keep UX focused and infra cheap.
Priya S: Love that framing. Customers want fast answers during an incident: which route, which model_version, how much cost burned, and a few redacted examples.
Evan K: Ops constraints: full-span indexing is the big cost. Snapshot-first lets us store small exemplars + aggregated metrics and avoid heavy trace index. We can keep exemplars 14 days for pilots.
Ruth L: From CS: Finance and Platform teams like a per-api-key breakdown for cost attribution (not just route). Can we include api_key as a structured field in the snapshot?
Noah V: Proposal for snapshot-MVP:
- Snapshot page (one click from alert): top offending route, model_version, api_key, p99 delta, token spend delta (24h), quick CSV/JSONL export for billing.
- Error grouping: group by exception signature + model_version + route, show 3 redacted examples inline (14d exemplar retention).
- Tracing: header-based tag X-RW-SNAPSHOT: route=/v1/generate;model=rw-7b;api_key=acct-123;ver=2026-09-01 parsed into structured tags.
- Sampling policy: default sample-on-error; proportional reservoir sampling for high-traffic routes; auto-boost sampling for 1h after a model_version rollout. Per-customer override for pilots.
Priya S: Export format: prefer newline-delimited JSON (JSONL) for exports so customers can ingest easily; include a billing_key column if provided by the customer. Also keep a downloadable CSV.
Evan K: Storage plan: exemplars (redacted) 14d, aggregated metrics 90d. We will cap enumerated model_version tags per customer to last 30 versions to prevent cardinality blowup.
Ruth L: Pilot acceptance checklist (FinRegCo + MedAI):
- Snapshot shows route + model_version + api_key and token spend delta for last 24h
- Error group opens and shows 3 redacted examples with prompt truncated
- Exports available as JSONL and CSV and match billing window
- UI shows a clear banner: "Snapshot beta: sampled traces, short exemplar retention"
Noah V: Trade-offs: snapshot-first loses some ad-hoc trace search, but customers can export raw exemplars to their S3 for deeper forensic during pilot. That keeps infra cost bounded.
Priya S: Legal note: for regulated pilots, raw prompt content must be redacted. Exports to S3 require signed export agreement. Ruth, I'll add that to the pilot checklist.
ops-bot: ops: obs-snapshot-canary scheduled 01:45 UTC tomorrow; will alert #eng-oncall on failure.
Evan K: Dev estimate: snapshot backend + header parsing + export path (2 sprints), frontend snapshot page + templates (1.5 sprints), error grouping infra + exemplar redaction (1.5 sprints) -> ~5 sprints. Can compress to 4 if we reuse export infra.
Ruth L: If we need to cut to hit time, deprioritize per-api-key breakdown and ship route+model_version first. Customers prefer the snapshot itself more than extra filters.
Noah V: Decision: ship snapshot-MVP = snapshot page + JSONL/CSV exports + header tagging + error groups with 14d exemplars. Stretch: per-api-key breakdown and raw-span drilldown.
Priya S: Action items:
- Evan: header spec + sampling defaults + enumerated-tag GC plan (due Fri)
- Ruth: pilot acceptance checklist + legal export checklist (due Mon)
- Noah: draft external beta language and UI banner with comms (due Tue)
- Priya: confirm FinRegCo/MedAI OK with 14d exemplar retention (due Tue)
comms-bot: comms: use phrasing "Snapshot beta: sampled traces, short exemplar retention, JSONL exports" in public materials.
Ruth L: +1
Evan K: +1
Priya S: +1
Noah V: Thanks all. I'll file the RFC and loop in CTL for go/no-go.
